scope: Only private current resource success-proof reuse for three compiled assets. Isolated /tmp; no installation, product/source/service/DB/APKG/Git/UI changes; no big DOM or producer.

cases: real resource + compiled load reuses three current successful SHA proofs
untrusted reader and fake resource take the original three matches
getter only accepts exact primitive text/pin/current URL task, never pending
bad SHA and partial ranges reject; failed cache is removed and can retry
fulfilled proof survives no owner, but only within the original 24 task cache
evicted old completion never proves a newer same-key pending task
resource and matcher exceptions preserve the same error without a false proof
owner cancellation after assets does not parse/publish and new owner still works
private proof bookkeeping throw safely falls back without changing resource success
tests.red_fact: Actual resource + load functions execute 6 matches for three assets. New first contract expects 3 and fails 6 !== 3 on baseline.
tests.green_fact: Verified resource path calls exactly 3 original matches; recheck reuses only strict private success proof. Fake readers still call the original matches even for identical cached strings.
tests.source_method: The harness extracts actual resource and complete makeCompiledProfileSupport source from the sealed FRAME. It supplies minimal network/crypto fixture dependencies, not a replacement loader implementation. No DOM/browser surrogate.

private_proof.success: Record only in a fulfilled task reaction after all original HTTP/full206/UTF8 length/knownPinMatches checks and after original verified phase hook; failure reaction has no record. Recording exceptions cannot change original task success.
private_proof.record: WeakMap key is the original private resource task, value is {text,pin}, both primitive strings. No packet, owner, DOM, descriptor or caller bool.
private_proof.getter: Reader must be the exact lexical original resource function; URL/pin cache key must still point to the same successful private task; expected pin and primitive string exact value must match. Query/full URL identity preserved. Unknown, pending, evicted, replaced, fake-reader, malformed or throwing metadata access returns false.
private_proof.lifetime: No additional strong key/task map or public proof API. The original scriptCache remains exactly 24 tasks with original eviction/failure behavior. Weak proof values reference the same immutable string already held as task result; no copy, no cross-refresh string cache, no owner callbacks. Evicted private tasks cannot be used as proofs even if a caller still awaits their results.
private_proof.fallback: Only getter===true avoids matches. Every other case calls the original matches with text and expected pin; errors and false values retain original rejection.
private_proof.timing: Adds a success-bookkeeping reaction, no new await/timer/geometry/selector or message. Existing three resources still load concurrently; original checks and source/author order remain unchanged.

preserved: Source/module/raw/compiled expected pins and their original first resource validation
Complete Range/UTF8-length/SHA policy, URL query, promise cache bound and failed-task identity cleanup
Existing owner checks before/after assets and recheck; no old owner or failed current task can publish
Existing compiled JSON parse/freeze/profile bindings, initial numbering claim, authored order, Cigen/layout/native/fonts/3stable/10s gate
Original phase labels and counts, existing diagnostic API/collector boundaries
limit: The observed 142ms prior recheck window is the only target, not an established whole-card speed result. Actual isolated Safari still required by root.
cpu: All Node syntax and nine focused contracts exited; no owned active CPU/UI/producer process.
